propositions: The test intermittently kills its xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to per-test timeout (300s) being exceeded, not OOM or pandoc failure.
The test's cost is unbounded and load-dependent: 91.6s idle, 504.8s under CPU saturation (1.7x the 300s guard), because it serially processes 884 corpus units each rendered twice.
Pytest-timeout's thread method calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the worker without traceback or assertion text, causing xdist to report 'node down: Not properly terminated'.
The fix chunks the monolithic test into fixed-size parametrized cases using _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK constant, bounding per-test cost independent of corpus growth and allowing xdist work distribution.

The byte-identity property is preserved: all 884 units are still compared with _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE=1 and real pandoc on both sides, with a new coverage guard asserting chunk concatenation equals full _renderable_units().
